economy.summary: His official biography says he is committed to creating a business-friendly environment so more family-sustaining jobs are created by small business owners, to reducing regulations, and to supporting Pennsylvania's agriculture industry.
economy.short: Supports business-friendly environment, fewer regulations, small-business job creation.

taxes.summary: Voted against the 2026-27 state budget in July 2026, saying it spends billions more than the state will receive in revenue and defers more than $1.3 billion in Medicaid payments; said he will keep working to get the state's recurring structural deficit under control.
taxes.short: Voted no on 2026-27 state budget, citing deficit spending.

abortion.summary: Voted in July 2022 for Senate Bill 106, a proposed amendment to the Pennsylvania Constitution providing that there is no constitutional right to taxpayer-funded abortion or other right relating to abortion; the measure passed the House 107-92.
abortion.short: Voted for amendment stating no state constitutional abortion right.

education.summary: In his statement on the 2026-27 state budget, cited as achievements the addition of $10 million for career and technical education and the protection of the Educational Improvement Tax Credit program, which funds school choice scholarships.
education.short: Cites career-tech funding, school-choice tax credit as budget wins.

healthcare.summary: In a 2020 iVoterGuide candidate survey, strongly disagreed that government should ensure health insurance coverage, saying the private market should be allowed to function without government interference.
healthcare.short: Said private market, not government, should handle health coverage.

energy.summary: Says Pennsylvania should abandon the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, which he says would hinder natural gas and coal production and increase utility bills by nearly 40 percent, and calls the governor's PACER plan a costly carbon tax under a different name; says the state should embrace Pennsylvania energy production.
energy.short: Opposes RGGI and PACER; supports natural gas, coal production.

guns.summary: Opposed a slate of gun control bills advancing through the House Judiciary Committee in January 2024, saying that if the government can infringe on Second Amendment rights, no rights can be enjoyed by citizens of this nation.
guns.short: Opposes gun control bills, citing Second Amendment rights.
